memory_update.text: SPSC should be carried forward as the highest-quality underfollowed candidate for retail product-data and trading-partner infrastructure; next layer must prove AI-shopping relevance beyond generic supply-chain SaaS.
CRTO is a small-cap commerce-media/retail-media candidate with measurable retailer and brand network evidence, but must be separated from legacy retargeting and broader adtech cyclicality.
RAMP maps to retail media clean rooms and measurement rather than product content itself; carry as second-order data-collaboration exposure with regulatory and M&A status checks.

CMRC is the cleanest direct public mapping to product-feed and agentic catalog exports via Feedonomics, but its below-$300M market cap and business turnaround risks require speculative_shadow treatment.

Many best-fit product information management, review, syndication and marketplace optimization assets are private or acquired: Salsify, Syndigo, Bazaarvoice, PowerReviews, CommerceIQ, Rithum/ChannelAdvisor and Profitero. Public-market mapping is therefore imperfect and likely indirect.

For this node, strongest evidence gates are not AI mentions but measurable growth in product-feed/catalo​​g syndication, retailer onboarding, retail-media contribution, same-retailer retention, clean-room usage, catalog error reduction and inventory/content accuracy workflows.

node: AI-mediated shopping, retail data and product-content infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed or US-traded public assets one or two steps away from obvious consumer ecommerce leaders. The strongest underfollowed fit is SPS Commerce as retail supply-chain/product-data plumbing. Criteo and LiveRamp map to retail-media activation, measurement and data collaboration. Commerce.com is a below-$300M speculative exception because Feedonomics directly touches product-feed quality and emerging agentic catalog exports, but company-level execution and scale risk are high. Mega-cap retailers, marketplaces and search platforms remain context anchors rather than alpha-hunt candidates for this pass.
